ai.seo_question: What does the verse 'Nor will I worship what you worship' signify in Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as the final revelation regarding religious pluralism, establishing 'Tawhid al-Ibadah' (oneness of worship) as distinct from mere belief. It underscores the Prophet's (peace be upon him) absolute independence from the polytheists of Quraysh, serving as a perpetual model for the faithful to maintain doctrinal purity and avoid syncretism in their devotional practices.
